title: Courtesy Late Fee Waiver Allowances — Apartment Home Lease
content:
Three floor plan values bound the courtesy late fee waiver on an Apartment Home Lease: how many courtesy waivers are available within the trailing 365 days, how many full calendar months since move-in must have passed before one is available, and whether ACH autopay must be enrolled for one to be available.

| Floor plan | Courtesy waivers available within the trailing 365 days | Minimum full calendar months since move-in | ACH autopay enrollment required |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 1 | 6 | Yes |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 1 | 6 | Yes |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 1 | 6 | Yes |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 1 | 6 | Yes |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 1 | 6 | Yes |
| Penthouse Residence | 1 | 3 | No |

**Guidance on the table**

- Every floor plan allows 1 courtesy waiver within the trailing 365 days.
- The tenure minimum is 6 full calendar months since move-in on five floor plans and 3 on the Penthouse Residence.
- Autopay enrollment is a requirement on five floor plans; the Penthouse Residence carries no autopay requirement.
